suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify the TDD step to allow minimal scaffolding for new-package features before the first failing test run, while still requiring tests to be added and exercised before behavior-finalization commits.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Review eval-harness-framework noted backend-worker skill red-phase expectation conflicted with practical sequence in worker session fdfae1f5-f845-43f3-ac7b-4a06e1d48177 (scaffolding patches before first targeted go test).

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Strengthen enforcement language for large React page exceptions by requiring explicit handoff decomposition checkpoints whenever a component materially exceeds the ~200-line guidance.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Review eval-harness-ui found EvalPage.tsx at ~478 lines without decomposition notes in the feature handoff despite mission guidance exception requirements.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify Integration Verification expectations so workers either provide interactiveChecks or explicitly document why command-based verification was sufficient when interactive UI validation is not required.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Review eval-harness-ui observed commandsRun-only verification with no interactiveChecks, while skill text expects interactive verification details.
